svg.title: The NavisWORLD cosmic workshop
svg.desc: An arched walnut cabinet lit by brass lamps. A brown dragon with amber eyes, fire wings, burgundy toes and a cyan save tag holds a crystal inside its central glass habitat. Code, model familiars, a purple handheld, CST notes and a watch concept occupy the surrounding shelves. The save tag is an artwork motif, not a claimed runtime field.
